items.text: Replace success-only `AgentActivationResolutionDecision` with one closed semantic-resolution result, e.g.: Resolved(binding); TaskSelectionRequired(candidates/handle); ScopeAmbiguous(candidates/handle); NotReady(recovery handle); StaleFence; FailedInternal(failure handle).
Kernel remains the sole transport Session/fence owner. A daemon denial/result is semantic input, not authority.
Submit the exact terminal semantic result once under the ticket digest/idempotency identity.
Retry/reclaim only when the result explicitly says transient and names a changed dependency or next retry time. Repeating the same owner state without a discriminator is prohibited.
Map expected no-task/ambiguous-task outcomes to the agent-facing TASK_SELECTION_REQUIRED / AMBIGUOUS_RESULT contract without waiting for ticket expiry.
Map stale/fence mismatch fail-closed without creating a Session.
An internal mapping/owner error creates a bounded failure record/diagnostic evidence; it is not downgraded to task ambiguity.
Expiry remains Kernel-owned and wins races, but does not erase a previously submitted exact semantic result.
No active task returns typed task selection immediately.
Multiple active bindings return typed ambiguity with bounded candidate handles.
Same ticket/state is not semantically resolved more than once unless a declared transient dependency changes.
A stale/future/cross-lineage fence creates no Session.
Internal resolver failure is visible and cannot loop silently until timeout.
Exact decision replay is idempotent; conflicting decision for one ticket is rejected.
Kernel/daemon loss and deadline races preserve one terminal agent-visible disposition.
